parts.description: An ornate, antique-style gold picture frame with a textured surface and an MDF or cardboard easel back.
parts.reasoning: The object is a typical decorative picture frame. The ornate, detailed casing is usually made of a cast polyurethane resin or plastic designed to mimic wood or metal, which forms the bulk of the object's mass and volume. The backing and stand are made of MDF or heavy cardboard. I have selected 'plastic' as the dominant material representing the dense resin frame. The mass is estimated at 0.6 kg, typical for an 8x10 or 5x7 inch heavy decorative frame. Friction and restitution values are selected for rigid plastic/resin. For collision modeling in Isaac Sim, a convex decomposition is highly recommended because the object has a complex, non-convex overall shape due to the easel stand protruding from the flat back, and the recessed inner section. The stand implies a 1-DOF revolute joint if articulated, requiring joint friction and damping to maintain its standing pose.
